SELECT ac.arbitrage_check_id, ac.contract_id, c.contract_no, ac.payment_stage, ac.as_of_date, ac.contract_month_no, ac.cumulative_paid_premium, ac.paid_commission_amount, ac.planned_commission_amount, ac.included_surrender_value_amount, ac.net_difference_amount, ac.refund_addition_applied_yn, ac.surrender_value_source_type, ac.result_status, ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason' AS decision_reason FROM arbitrage_check ac JOIN insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = ac.contract_id
ORDER BY ac.arbitrage_check_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ac.result_status = 'CLEAR') AS clear_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ac.result_status = 'CANDIDATE') AS candidate_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ac.result_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS review_required_count FROM arbitrage_check ac JOIN insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = ac.contract_id

SELECT c.contract_id, c.contract_date, c.insurer_id, p.product_id, c.product_offering_id, c.payment_term_months, po.channel_code, po.standard_deduction_80_yn, c.standard_surrender_deduction_amount, fs.as_of_date AS snapshot_as_of_date, fs.contract_month_no, fs.cumulative_paid_premium, fs.surrender_value, fs.surrender_value_type, fs.refund_rate_table_id AS snapshot_refund_rate_table_id FROM insurance_contract c JOIN product_offering po ON po.product_offering_id = c.product_offering_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cfs.as_of_date, cfs.contract_month_no, cfs.cumulative_paid_premium, cfs.surrender_value, cfs.surrender_value_type, cfs.refund_rate_table_id FROM contract_financial_snapshot cfs WHERE cfs.contract_id = c.contract_id AND cfs.as_of_date <= #{asOfDate} ORDER BY cfs.as_of_date DESC, CASE WHEN cfs.surrender_value_type = 'ACTUAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cfs.contract_financial_snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) fs ON true WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.cashflow_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN ROUND(ta.attributed_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.cashflow_type = 'DEDUCTION' THEN ROUND(ta.attributed_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_deduction_amount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ct.cashflow_type = 'DEDUCTION' THEN -ROUND(ta.attributed_amount, 0) ELSE ROUND(ta.attributed_amount, 0) END ), 0) AS paid_commission_amount FROM transaction_attribution ta JOIN commission_transaction ct ON ct.commission_transaction_id = ta.commission_transaction_id WHERE ta.contract_id = #{contractId} AND ct.payment_stage = #{paymentStage} AND ct.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ta.attribution_date <= #{asOfDate}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(sl.expected_amount, 0)), 0) FROM schedule_header sh JOIN schedule_line sl ON sl.schedule_header_id = sh.schedule_header_id WHERE sh.contract_id = #{contractId} AND sh.payment_stage = #{paymentStage} AND sh.active_yn = true AND sh.schedule_purpose = 'OPERATIONAL' AND sl.line_status = 'PLANNED'

SELECT rrt.refund_rate_table_id, rrl.refund_rate_pct FROM refund_rate_table rrt JOIN refund_rate_line rrl ON rrl.refund_rate_table_id = rrt.refund_rate_table_id WHERE rrt.insurer_id = #{source.insurerId} AND rrt.product_id = #{source.productId} AND rrt.payment_term_months = #{source.paymentTermMonths} AND rrt.channel_code = #{source.channelCode} AND (rrt.product_offering_id IS NULL OR rrt.product_offering_id = #{source.productOfferingId}) AND rrt.standard_deduction_80_yn = true AND rrt.effective_from <= #{source.contractDate} AND (rrt.effective_to IS NULL OR rrt.effective_to >= #{source.contractDate}) AND rrl.contract_month_no = #{source.contractMonthNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN rrt.product_offering_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rrt.effective_from DESC, rrt.refund_rate_table_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO arbitrage_check ( validation_run_id, contract_id, payment_stage, as_of_date, contract_month_no, cumulative_paid_premium, paid_commission_amount, planned_commission_amount, included_surrender_value_amount, refund_addition_applied_yn, surrender_value_source_type, net_difference_amount, refund_rate_table_id, standard_deduction_80_yn, result_status, calculation_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, #{paymentStage}, #{asOfDate}, #{contractMonthNo}, #{cumulativePaidPremium}, #{paidCommissionAmount}, #{plannedCommissionAmount}, #{includedSurrenderValueAmount}, #{refundAdditionAppliedYn}, #{surrenderValueSourceType}, #{netDifferenceAmount}, #{refundRateTableId}, #{standardDeduction80Yn}, #{resultStatus}, #{calculationSnapshot}::jsonb )
mapper.select: SELECT ac.arbitrage_check_id, ac.contract_id, c.contract_no, ac.payment_stage, ac.as_of_date, ac.contract_month_no, ac.cumulative_paid_premium, ac.paid_commission_amount, ac.planned_commission_amount, ac.included_surrender_value_amount, ac.net_difference_amount, ac.refund_addition_applied_yn, ac.surrender_value_source_type, ac.result_status, ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason' AS decision_reason FROM arbitrage_check ac JOIN insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = ac.contract_id WHERE ac.contract_id = #{contractId} AND ac.payment_stage = #{paymentStage} ORDER BY ac.as_of_date ASC, ac.arbitrage_check_id ASC
SELECT vt.contract_id FROM validation_target vt WHERE vt.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND vt.selection_status = 'SELECTED' ORDER BY vt.contract_id
